paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s football team will travel to New Hope on Friday, Oct. 23, for a 7 p.m. game at Trojan Field. A new game-day flyer from Pontotoc Athletics identifies the kickoff time and venue, and the school’s official 2026–27 varsity schedule confirms the road date.

The Warriors return home the following Friday, Oct. 30, to face Columbus at 7 p.m. The official schedule designates that game as senior night, giving fans two different locations to plan for over the next two Fridays.
After senior night, the next listed road game is Thursday, Nov. 5, at Lafayette, also at 7 p.m. The school’s complete varsity schedule is linked below for fans checking these upcoming dates.
